name: Nitco Ltd
tagline: Loss-making tile maker with negative returns, revenue in multi-year decline and ~67% of promoter holding pledged -- turnaround remains unproven
business_overview: Nitco makes ceramic and vitrified tiles, marble and mosaic, plus a small realty vertical. It has a long history of debt restructuring.
fundamentals_table: ~67.1% of promoter holding pledged; low interest coverage
Q1 revenue fell to ~Rs 120 Cr from ~Rs 150 Cr YoY; net loss ~Rs 10 Cr vs a profit YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Both the trailing record and the latest quarter are weak: negative ROE/ROCE, revenue declining for years, a widening loss in the most recent quarter, low interest coverage and about two-thirds of promoter holding pledged. The 'turnaround' thesis has no supporting evidence in the numbers.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-read this pass. Filtered at the preliminary stage: a loss-making company with negative returns, multi-year revenue decline, a widening recent-quarter loss and a heavy promoter pledge, with no catalyst that is actually visible in the results.
bse_notes: High promoter pledge (~67%) and low interest coverage are the standout concerns; long history of debt restructuring.
bull_case: Established tile brand with pan-India distribution
Optionality if the housing cycle and a genuine operational turnaround materialise
bear_case: Negative ROE/ROCE; net loss widening in the most recent quarter
~67% of promoter holding pledged; low interest coverage
No evidence of an actual turnaround in the results
